name: Evergreen International Storage & Transport Corp
summary: Evergreen International Storage & Transport Corporation is a Taiwanese enterprise offering a broad spectrum of logistics and transportation services. Its operations in Taiwan encompass container trucking, management of container distribution centers, ship chartering, operating fuel stations, and passenger transportation. The company's comprehensive inland container terminal services include lifting operations, managing the flow of incoming and outgoing containers, storing and inspecting imported goods, warehousing for Less than Container Load (LCL) exports, operating bonded warehouses, and providing container repair, cleaning, and general distribution center storage. Furthermore, it facilitates internal container transportation for the shipping and trade sectors, covering shipside logistics, general container movement, long-haul journeys, specialized hovercraft transportation, and the handling of unique or oversized containers. Moreover, the company provides an extensive array of port and shipping services, including ship berthing, stevedoring (encompassing loading, discharging, and transshipment), container storage and transition, handling the receipt and delivery of cargo and containers, stuffing and stripping cargo into/from containers, reconsolidating transshipped freight, container repair and cleaning, garment-on-hanger services, comprehensive container inspection and management, and customs clearance. Beyond its core logistics operations, Evergreen International Storage & Transport Corporation runs gasoline stations selling various fuels and CPC-branded lubricants, operates bus-based passenger transportation, and provides vehicle maintenance and inspection services. Its offerings further include management consulting and employment agency services. Established in 1973, the company is headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.
